reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily skipping in multiple consumers.

duplication.why: The skipped-day predicate, daily-frequency dispatch, and recurrence-advancement loop are repeated rather than shared.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared schedules, but server handlers also own scheduling policy that should reside alongside it.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested schedule rules, range handler, configuration plumbing, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate scheduling policy across shared utilities, two handlers, and budget iteration, including a separately maintained adjustment-window heuristic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts independently dispatches daily skipping in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange; server/budget/schedule-template.ts retains two getNextDate(..., true) paths with local adjustment.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily occurrence handling is reshaped into forward recurrence traversal in getUpcomingDates, bidirectional traversal in getNextDate, and filtering in getDatesInRange, while each repeats the daily/non-daily policy.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the holidays parameter and shared getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch; two server handlers and two budget adjustment sites independently apply scheduling policy outside that branch.
